question: Each of D, E, G, H, S, T, and Y has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. G's exam is on one of the days before H. E has the exam on Thursday. Only two person have exams between S and E. D has the exam on the day immediately after S. T has the exam on the day immediately before Y, but not on Saturday. G does not have the exam on Sunday. Who among the following has the exam on Friday?

3) D has the exam on the day immediately after S.
